typesense:trending.greeting:
It was a beautiful day in Avengers Tower. Tony tinkered with a suit, sparks flying and a faint smell of ozone in the air. Steve did push-ups, forehead glistening. Thor strummed his instrument lazily, humming a low tune. Bruce scribbled formulas, mumbling numbers. Natasha dodged Clint’s arrows with precise grace. Clint fired at targets, smirking. Wanda flipped through her book, sunlight catching the edges of the pages. Vision floated silently, his synthetic skin reflecting the soft light. Peter fiddled with his web-shooters, fingers trembling slightly. Bucky leaned against the wall, silent and observant. Quill lounged on the couch, tossing snacks at Parker, who barely caught them.

Nick Fury entered, followed by a woman whose blonde hair shimmered in the sunlight.

Wanda looked up, smiling softly. “Who is this?”

“This is Ava,” Fury said. “She’ll be joining the team.”

Wanda stepped forward. “Welcome—”

Ava cut her off, bouncing slightly, voice loud and sugary, glitter sparkling across her short outfit as it caught the light. She twirled once, hair flipping dramatically, eyes scanning the room, chest leaning forward to show off her cleavage. “OMG hiiiiii~!” She waved energetically at everyone, nails glinting in the sunlight.

Natasha froze mid-step, arms crossed. “Ugh… really?” she muttered.

Steve stopped mid-push-up, expression blank. “I… okay…” he said, voice small.

Thor’s strumming hand hovered in the air, eyebrow raised. “By Odin… she is… something,” he admitted.

Bruce blinked at his whiteboard. “This is… unexpected,” he murmured.

Clint chuckled under his breath. “Well, that’s a first.”

Wanda tilted her head, trying not to laugh. “Um… hi, I guess?”

Peter Parker squeaked. “Oh… wow…”

Tony finally look up from his bench, one eyebrows raised smirk forming. "Guess this is going to be a peaceful day". He said dry and sassy.
